sequential_dependency.intermediate: The unique ring depth and its full-square bounding box; for the retained case depth=2, color=7, ring box=[2,2,15,15], strict-interior box=[3,3,14,14].
sequential_dependency.step_a: Construct the complete concentric square from the monochrome row sequence, then locate the sole ring color that appears once.
sequential_dependency.step_b: Crop the strict interior of the located ring from the constructed square.
sequential_dependency.why_b_depends_on_a: The ring depth determines all four crop boundaries, so B cannot know the output dimensions or which inner layers survive until A locates the input-dependent marker ring.
